name: dialogue-captions
description: Cross-browser YouTube subtitle dialogue panel extension.

scripts.build:firefox:xpi: npm run build && npm run package:firefox
scripts.build:chrome:zip: npm run build && npm run package:chrome
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run test && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.release:sanity: npm run release:check && npm run package:source && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-release-artifacts.ps1
